['Gas-Union GmbH '].company_description: Gas-Union GmbH operates as a group of over 20 companies active in the European energy industry, employing about 1,600 people. It serves as a gas importer and wholesaler, operates critical gas infrastructure, and is central to the secure supply of gas in Germany. The company offers products such as calorimeters, multi-gas analyzers, pressure and temperature measuring equipment, leak test systems, pressure test kits, taping testers, energy metering systems, and gas analyzers.

['Hornbach-Baumarkt AG '].company_description: Hornbach-Baumarkt AG operates as the largest operating subgroup of the HORNBACH Holding AG & Co. KGaA Group, which pools the Europe-wide do-it-yourself (DIY) retail business with DIY stores and garden centers. The company owns more than half the properties used for its retail operations. Its net sales in Germany grew by 2.9% in the 2022/23 financial year, reaching EUR 2,861 million. The company's consolidated sales increased by 6.6% to EUR 6.3 billion, with 93% contributed by HORNBACH Baumarkt AG.
